name: Can I install kitchen cabinets myself, or do I need a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I install kitchen cabinets myself, or do I need a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While seasoned DIYers can assemble flat-pack boxes, professional installation is strongly recommended for structural alignment and durability. Kitchen cabinets carry hundreds of pounds of cookware and support heavy stone countertops. Professional installers know how to find studs, anchor into solid framing, shim out wall bows, and execute seamless miter cuts on crown molding. Poor installation can lead to sagging boxes, cracked countertops, and doors that refuse to stay aligned.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional installation is best because cabinets support heavy loads and stone counters, requiring exact leveling, stud fastening, and clean finish carpentry.
